contradictions.explanation: With only three houses, Esme, Kai, and Gus being pairwise in different houses forces each to occupy one distinct house, which is possible, but combined with Gia also needing a house (implied as a member of the community) this leaves no consistent assignment since the text gives no fourth house for Gia while treating her as part of the same group.
